newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eramet forecasts drop in 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Eramet forecasts drop in 1996 profit.

text.p: French nickel and steel producer Eramet said on Thursday it expected a significant drop in net attributable profit for 1996.
"Hopes for recovery in demand in the group's main markets in the fourth quarter remain uncertain," the company said in a statement with first-half results.
It added that in the absence of a pick up in nickel prices, "the group's net attributable profit for the year should be significantly lower than that for 1995 (357 million francs pre exceptionals)."
Eramet posted first half net attributable profit of 167 million francs versus 174 million a year ago.
